page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; catchword "Illis" at lower right; no marginal notes.

main_text.l: de putabant ex sanctis alios tardius re-
adhuc illud à multis memorationi piè
Toto ergò cœlo differt praxis ho-
diernæ ecclesiæ Romanæ à veteris ec-
tantùm. Illi pro sanctis in æterna fe-
ta versantibus. Illis nulla mentio pur-
gatorii, eo tempore incogniti: his cre-
brò. Illis preces erant vota, his merita.

page.notes: The line "Gott wölle jhm ein fröliche aufferstendnuß verleyhen." is in black letter, rendered here as bl. Some words in the first lines are faint; "Parae" in the running head is read from the abbreviation "Paral." as printed. Marginal mark "•" beside "adhuc" is a printer's mark, not transcribed.
